title: Earthy Whole30-Friendly Cheese-Pull Portuguese Cheese Bake
description: A nostalgic Portuguese dish featuring caramelized onions, garlic powder, and a rich cheese pull, all made with Whole30-friendly ingredients in a traditional kazán cauldron.

ingredients.name: grated cheddar cheese
ingredients.notes: Whole30-friendly, such as sheep9 milk or aged grass-fed beef

ingredients.name: grated parmesan cheese
ingredients.notes: Whole30-friendly, such as sheep9 milk or aged grass-fed beef

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in the kazán cauldron over medium-high heat.
Sear the ground beef until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Remove the beef from the cauldron and set aside.
Add the sliced onions to the cauldron and cook, stirring occasionally, until caramelized, about 20 minutes.
Add the garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to the cauldron and stir to combine.
Add the cubed sweet potatoes to the cauldron and stir to combine.
Return the beef to the cauldron and stir to combine.
Transfer the cauldron to the oven and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25 minutes.
Remove the cauldron from the oven and stir in the grated cheddar and parmesan cheese until melted and gooey.
Transfer the cheesy bake to a serving dish and garnish with chopped parsley and thyme.
Serve hot, straight from the cauldron.
